title: JakeSB - Aurora
htmlContent:
JakeSB took the world by storm as he again divulged another hit single titled "Aurora." Drawing inspiration from legends like Lil Uzi Vert, Trippie Redd, and Juice WRLD.

JakeSB is not your average Trap(Hip-Hop) artist and is ready to take over the game. His new song "Aurora" drift away from regular Hip Hop as he goes for a heavy trap style over the banging instrumental. 

"Aurora" displays an eccentric, carefree style that distinguishes him from the current crop of granular hip-hop-influenced music. In all seriousness, his music will make a fan of any Gen-Z music lover.

JakeSB "Aurora" is available on all streaming platforms!
